description: This class provides static utility methods for enabling strict mode and detecting Android platform versions, primarily used for debugging and compatibility checks within the contacts list application.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods for enabling strict mode and checking Android OS version compatibility.

methods.name: enableStrictMode
methods.description: Enables strict mode policies for debugging, with version-specific features and instance limits for activities.

methods.name: hasGingerbread
methods.description: Checks if the device's OS version is Gingerbread (API level 9) or higher.

methods.name: hasHoneycomb
methods.description: Checks if the device's OS version is Honeycomb (API level 11) or higher.

methods.name: hasHoneycombMR1
methods.description: Checks if the device's OS version is Honeycomb MR1 (API level 12) or higher.

methods.name: hasICS
methods.description: Checks if the device's OS version is Ice Cream Sandwich (API level 14) or higher.
